title: Polynomial-time unary producer clock
statement: For all natural numbers $C,e,c,A,d$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the unary word of length $c\bigl(A(|x|+C(|x|+1)^e+1)^d+1\bigr)^2+1$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For all parameters $C, e, c, A, d$, the function sending an input $x$ to the unary word of the producer horizon at $|x|$ plus one true token is polynomial-time computable; the horizon is read off the inherited arithmetic header, and the extra token accounts for the inclusive final row.
